title: He broke the world record for speed skateboarding in Quebec | The Moment
summary: Downhill skateboarder Diego Poncelet tells The National about the moment he beat the speed skateboarding record, reaching 151.83 km/h down the Route du Fleuve in Charlevoix's Les Éboulements, Quebec.
